findings.title: Retry button on a failed takeover request always fails
findings.body: `retryJobRequest` sends every non-replace request through `createJobRequest`, which calls `checkRequest`. That only accepts `link` and `prompt` and throws `Mode must be "link" or "prompt".` for `takeover`. The dashboard's StartProblems list shows Retry for every `failed` request with no mode check, and the server route `/api/job-requests/:id/retry` calls `retryJobRequest` directly. So a takeover that failed (now including the new UNREGISTERED failure, which is left to the Client after one retry) gives the Client a Retry button that always returns an error. The Client's only way forward is the job page's Start new Staff. Fix: in `retryJobRequest`, send a `takeover` request to `startStaffForJob(ctx, r.job_id)`, the same way `failUnregisteredStarts` does, and add a test for it.

findings.title: A late Staff can still read or register a request this change already failed
findings.body: `failUnregisteredStarts` marks a request `failed` and queues a second one. Neither `readJobRequest` nor `lockRequestForRegistration` checks for `failed`. They only check `cancelled`, `registered`, `job_id` and `staff_agent_id`. Path: the first session is slow to connect, so it passes the 3-minute mark. The scheduler sets the request to `failed` (`staff_agent_id` is still null) and queues the retry. The slow session then calls `get_job_request`. The read succeeds, sets `staff_agent_id`, and for a takeover reassigns the job to it. For a prompt it returns the prompt, and `register_job` creates a job. Meanwhile the retry Staff does the same thing, so two Staff work on one job, or two jobs come from one prompt. Fix: have both readers refuse a request whose status is `failed` (or that was retried or dismissed), or have the read path take the status check under the same `FOR UPDATE` lock. The PR only guards the opposite race, where the scheduler sees a Staff that already read.

findings.title: The takeover branch of the new retry has no test
findings.body: `failUnregisteredStarts` sends a takeover request to `startStaffForJob` and a link or prompt request to `retryJobRequest`. The new tests only cover a prompt request. Nothing checks that a stuck takeover is failed and queued once with `takeover` mode and its `job_id`, that a second failure is left alone, or that `startStaffForJob` refusing (for example, the owner came back) is caught without an error. The `replace` skip is also untested. Add a test for the takeover branch beside the existing one in `test/job-sources.test.ts`.

findings.title: A Staff that reads a request after it was failed still claims it, so the retry starts a duplicate Staff and job
findings.body: failUnregisteredStarts marks a request failed when no Staff has read it within 3 minutes, and queues a retry. The failed session is not stopped. readJobRequest (src/job-requests.ts:339-341) locks the row and checks only staff_agent_id; it never checks status, so a 'failed' request is still served and claimed. lockRequestForRegistration (src/job-requests.ts:413-416) has the same gap, and jobs.ts:133 uses it for register_job. Path: session S1 is slow to start. At 3 min the request R1 is set to failed and R2 is queued. S2 starts from R2. At 4 min S1 calls get_job_request(R1): readJobRequest accepts it, sets staff_agent_id = S1 and returns the prompt. S1 calls register_job(R1), which creates a job. S2 registers R2 and creates a second job. For a prompt request there is no linear_issue_id to dedupe on, so two Staff run the same prompt. The PR's guard (staff_agent_id is null) does not cover a request that was already failed. Fix: readJobRequest and lockRequestForRegistration should refuse a request whose status is 'failed' (or cancelled, or dismissed), and tell the late session to end, in the same transaction that claims it.

findings.title: New recovery logic has no test for the takeover retry, the late reader, or a dismissed request
findings.body: The new test (test/job-sources.test.ts:217) covers only a link/prompt request that is never read. Three paths in the change have no test: (1) takeover retry, where failUnregisteredStarts calls startStaffForJob (src/job-requests.ts:265), which is never exercised; (2) a Staff that reads the request after it was failed, which the test at :239 does not cover. It only checks a request that was read before the grace period. This is the path where the duplicate in the P1 finding happens, so a test should fail today; (3) the dismissed_at IS NULL filter (src/job-requests.ts:252) is not tested. Add a takeover case and a late-read case that expects the late reader to be refused.
